subject: E-5181: cannot write data directory on Windows
body:
Hi, I'm using CourierOS 3.5.0 on Windows 11 23H2. Since
yesterday, every time I open the app, I get 'E-5181: cannot
write to data directory'.

The data directory lives on a network share mapped by IT.
When the machine wakes, the mapped share reconnects slowly.

I've already tried waiting a day, which changed nothing.

Regards, Sofia Rossi, Oakline Partners
